title: [spec-gap][R-04-018] Hop-limited broadcast relay absent in Rust; Python routes mesh multicast as external unicast (spec 04 6.3.2)
description:
Spec spec/04-network.md 6.3.2 (MUST-level relay behavior): sender broadcasts to mesh-local group with a Hop Limit; each relay MUST preserve the original IPv6 source address end-to-end, decrement Hop Limit, rebroadcast while Hop Limit > 0, consume locally at 0 — purely local decision, no routing table consulted.

Evidence:
- C: implemented. lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/router.c:627-655 (multicast relay: scope>=2 local ingress relay, scope>=3 && hop_limit>1 mesh ingress relay, forwarded_hop_limit decrement, DELIVER_AND_FORWARD); test lichen/tests/routing_dispatch/src/main.c:245-283 test_multicast_scope_and_boundary.
- Python: divergent. lichen/src/lichen/routing/router.py route() classifies ff02/ff03 multicast destinations via classify_address -> EXTERNAL -> _route_external() (unicast forwarding to RPL parent); no hop-limited flood relay. LOADng RREQ rebroadcast (lichen/src/lichen/loadng/discovery.py) is a different mechanism (spec 10). tests/routing/test_router.py only exercises BR filtering, not relay flooding.
- Rust: not-implemented. lichen-node has no generic IPv6 multicast relay (rpl_stack handles ff02::1a RPL control only; stack.rs:629 admission gate drops non-local/non-multicast; no rebroadcast path for ff03::fc / hop-limited data broadcasts).

Consequence: mesh-wide flood delivery (SOS, alerts, mesh-local broadcast) has no conformant data-plane implementation in Rust or Python; C is the only conformant relay.

Suggested placement: Rust lichen-node stack receive path (mirror C router.c multicast relay + §6.3.3 limiter per b7z9.129); Python router.py multicast branch (relay on scope>=2 with HL decrement + limiter admission) instead of EXTERNAL fallback.
